title: Hollow Tide
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A round, hollow FM sine sub-bass that walks an upbeat pattern in the lowest register while a slow filter journey opens and closes over 32 cycles. The FM index swells, the harmonicity steps, and a vowel-tinted formant breathes through the sub to give it a roaring, vocal undertow without ever leaving the bottom octave.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 [c1 eb1] g0 [c1 bb0]>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1.5, 9)).fmh("<0.5 1 1.5 2>/8")
    .penv("<0 12 -7 5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .vowel("<o u o a>/16")
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(120, 1900)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 16)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.14)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.05)
    .shape(0.3)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).room(0.2))
    .room(0.16).gain(0.92)
)
